data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 昏暗卧榻的吸血献身
data.description: 深夜微光流泻的公寓卧室内。为了唤醒第四真祖沉睡的眷兽，雪菜侧倚在床榻边，纤手轻解水手服领巾，露出修长白皙的颈项与精致锁骨。她微仰着脸，双眸含着动情的水汽，呼吸发烫，将自己的血脉与信任毫无保留地献给眼前的守护者。
data.action: 侧仰倚榻微解领口展露雪白颈项，双眸微合动情呼吸
data.lighting: 月光透窗冷蓝与床畔琥珀色暖灯明暗交错
data.camera: 第一人称特写微仰视，焦距集中于微红面庞与颈项
data.promptProse: In a dimly lit apartment bedroom bathed in cool moonlight and warm amber lamp glow, Yukina tilts her head back against plush pillows, delicately loosening her sailor uniform collar to reveal her slender pale neck and graceful collarbone. Her eyes gaze upward with breathless romantic surrender, cheeks flushed with warmth as soft shadows trace the contours of her throat.
data.animaCaption: Loosening her uniform collar on the bed in soft moonlight, she tilts her head with breathless devotion and flushed cheeks.
